title: Measure test-suite costs and propose coverage-preserving optimizations
outcome: A ranked measured inventory of Rust module, Node launcher and Vitest test costs identifies supported cause hypotheses and concrete coverage-preserving changes for coordinator approval before implementation.
acceptance: Record exact source/run identities and available duration evidence for Rust modules, Node launcher suites and Vitest files; distinguish artifact-derived times from new focused measurements and separate elapsed time from overlap/resource effects.

Rank major measured costs, give falsifiable hypotheses covering process spawn, Git fixture setup, sleeps/polls, serial locks and repeated setup as applicable, and propose optimizations that preserve assertions and coverage.

Return the measurement report and proposed fixes to Fable2 within the authorized read-only phase. New runs are focused, sequential and coordinated; no product/test fixes, skipped tests, weakened assertions or timeout changes occur before phase-two approval.
